nodes.label: NewEra365 Dark Favicon
nodes.description: Dark-theme favicon for NewEra365 web app. Shows the 'NEWERA' wordmark in white/light gray with a green candlestick chart icon replacing the 'N', on a transparent background. Used as the browser tab icon for the dark UI variant.

nodes.label: Favicon Light (NewEra Logo - Light Theme)
nodes.description: Light-theme favicon for NewEra365 web app. Displays the 'NEWERA' wordmark in bold black text on a white background. The letter 'N' incorporates a green candlestick chart graphic element — a small green bullish candlestick replacing or overlaying the vertical stroke — reinforcing the forex/CFD trading brand identity. Used as the browser tab icon for the light color scheme.

nodes.label: NewEra365 Brand Logo
nodes.description: The NewEra365 brand logo concept: 'NEWERA' wordmark with a green candlestick icon embedded in the letter N, symbolizing forex/CFD trading. Appears in both light and dark favicon variants.

nodes.label: Commodities Icon
nodes.description: Black and white line-art icon depicting a liquid/oil drop beside a stack of coins topped with a dollar-sign coin, representing commodities trading (oil/energy + financial value). Used as a navigation or category icon for the Commodities market section of the NewEra365 web app.

nodes.label: Feature Clock Icon (24/7)
nodes.description: Black-on-white PNG icon depicting a circular arrow (refresh/cycle) enclosing the text '24/7', representing round-the-clock availability. Used as a UI feature icon in the web app.

nodes.label: Feature Execution SVG Icon
nodes.description: SVG icon depicting a rabbit/speed symbol on a rounded square background (44x44 viewBox). Used as a feature icon for 'execution' quality (fast trade execution). Contains a rabbit-shaped vector path with CSS variable stroke/fill for theming.

nodes.label: Icon Box (Rounded Rectangle Background)
nodes.description: 44x44 rounded rect (rx=14) with fill var(--fill-0, #A6A6A6) at 8% opacity, forming the icon background.

nodes.label: Rabbit/Speed Icon Paths
nodes.description: Vector paths forming a rabbit silhouette, symbolising fast/speed execution. Stroke uses CSS variable --stroke-0 (default black), stroke-width 2, with round linecap and linejoin.

nodes.label: Forex Icon
nodes.description: Black and white outline icon depicting a hand receiving multiple currency coins (Yen, Pound, Dollar, Euro symbols), representing forex/foreign exchange trading. Used as a category icon in the web app's public icons directory.

nodes.label: Japanese Yen Currency Symbol
nodes.description: Yen (¥) coin depicted in the forex icon, representing JPY currency pairs in forex trading context.

nodes.label: British Pound Currency Symbol
nodes.description: Pound (£) coin depicted in the forex icon, representing GBP currency pairs in forex trading context.

nodes.label: US Dollar Currency Symbol
nodes.description: Dollar ($) coin depicted in the forex icon, representing USD currency pairs in forex trading context.

nodes.label: Euro Currency Symbol
nodes.description: Euro (€) coin depicted in the forex icon, representing EUR currency pairs in forex trading context.

nodes.label: Icon Box Execution
nodes.description: SVG-in-PNG icon depicting a 44x44 rounded rectangle box with a rabbit/speed symbol inside, used to represent fast order execution in the trading platform UI. The box background uses a CSS variable fill with low opacity, and the icon includes a vector path forming the execution symbol.

nodes.label: Icon Box Execution SVG Asset
nodes.description: SVG content embedded in a .png file: a 44x44 rounded rect (rx=14) with fill var(--fill-0, #A6A6A6) at 0.08 opacity, containing a rabbit/speed icon (id='rabbit 1') representing execution speed or fast trade execution feature.

nodes.label: Icon Earth Lock (SVG)
nodes.description: SVG icon depicting a globe (earth) with a padlock, used to represent geo-restricted or secure/locked global access. 24x24 viewBox, stroke-based line icon with variable stroke color. Used in the NewEra365 web frontend as a public static icon asset.

nodes.label: Market Commodities Icon
nodes.description: Black-and-white line icon depicting a liquid drop (representing oil or raw materials) alongside a stack of coins with a dollar sign, symbolizing commodities trading markets.

nodes.label: Commodities Market Visual Concept
nodes.description: Conceptual representation combining an oil/liquid drop with stacked dollar coins — standard iconographic shorthand for commodities markets (energy + precious metals/currency).

nodes.label: Market Crypto Icon (Bitcoin)
nodes.description: Black circular icon featuring the Bitcoin 'B' symbol in white. Used as the market category icon for cryptocurrency instruments in the NewEra365 trading platform UI.

nodes.label: Market ETFs Icon
nodes.description: Black-and-white line icon depicting a hand receiving multiple currency coins (Yen, Pound, Dollar, Euro), representing ETF or multi-currency market investment. Used as a UI icon for the ETFs market category.

nodes.label: Multi-Currency Coins Visual
nodes.description: Visual element within the icon: four currency coins showing Yen (¥), British Pound (£), US Dollar ($), and Euro (€) symbols, floating above an open hand.

nodes.label: Market Forex Icon
nodes.description: Black solid icon depicting two currency coins (dollar and euro) with circular exchange arrows, representing forex/currency trading. Used as a market category icon for the Forex section of the NewEra365 broker website.

nodes.label: Market Forex Icon
nodes.description: Black solid icon depicting two overlapping coins — one showing a US dollar sign and one showing a Euro sign — with circular arrows indicating currency exchange. Used as the forex market category icon in the NewEra365 web app.

nodes.label: Market Stocks Icon
nodes.description: Black-on-white line-art icon depicting three isometric 3D cubes arranged in a cluster with a checkmark circle badge overlaid on the top-right cube. Used as the market stocks category icon in the web frontend.

nodes.label: Isometric Cubes with Checkmark Badge
nodes.description: Visual metaphor combining stacked 3D blocks (representing asset/product stacking or portfolio) with a verification checkmark circle, symbolizing verified or tradeable stock instruments.

nodes.label: Performance Icon
nodes.description: Black outline icon combining a speedometer/gauge with a rising line chart (data points connected by lines with an upward arrow). Represents trading performance, execution speed, or growth metrics. Used as a UI icon in the web app public assets.

nodes.label: Regulated Icon (Court/Gavel)
nodes.description: Black and white line-art icon depicting a classical columned building (courthouse/government institution) overlaid with a judge's gavel, symbolizing financial regulation and legal compliance. Used as a trust/credibility badge on the NewEra365 broker website.

nodes.label: Support 24/7 Icon
nodes.description: Black monochrome icon depicting a circular arrow (refresh/cycle symbol) with '24/7' text in the center, representing round-the-clock customer support availability. Used as a UI icon asset in the web frontend.

nodes.label: Hero Chart Image
nodes.description: Black and white close-up photograph of a financial trading chart displayed on a screen. Shows candlestick price bars with a moving average line overlay, grid lines in the background, and shallow depth of field creating a dramatic bokeh effect on the edges. Used as a hero/background image on the website to establish a forex/CFD trading atmosphere.
nodes.purpose: Hero background image for the NewEra365 forex broker website, conveying financial markets and trading activity

nodes.label: NewEra Logo (Dark Theme)

nodes.label: NewEra Logo (Light Theme)
nodes.description: Light-theme variant of the NewEra365 brand logo. Displays 'NEWERA' wordmark in bold black uppercase text with a green bar chart icon to the left of the text, representing the brand identity for the forex/CFD broker website. Used on light-background contexts.

nodes.label: NewEra Green Bar Chart Icon
nodes.description: Small green bar/column chart icon positioned to the left of the 'NEWERA' wordmark in the light logo. Likely represents trading/financial growth motif for the brand.

nodes.label: Market Commodities Hero Image
nodes.description: AI-generated financial/commodities marketing image featuring stacked gold/copper coins with Bitcoin symbols, overlaid on financial charts including line charts, bar charts, and pie charts with blue and orange color scheme. Used as a hero or category image for the market commodities section of the NewEra365 forex/CFD broker website.

nodes.label: Market Crypto Hero Image
nodes.description: 3D rendered promotional image showing five cryptocurrency coin tokens arranged in a row against a dark background: Solana (black), Ethereum (teal/blue), Bitcoin (orange, center/largest), Binance Coin (yellow), and Tether (green). The coins have reflective surfaces beneath them. Used as a hero/category image for the crypto markets section of the NewEra365 forex/CFD broker website.
